[name]
[email] | [phone] | [url]
Jersey City, NJ

SUMMARY
Software engineer with ten years at JPMorgan Chase in the Corporate & Investment Bank technology division. Experienced in Java, Oracle and batch processing for post-trade systems. Reliable, detail-oriented and familiar with the firm's change-management and production-support processes. Comfortable with on-call support, release coordination and working with offshore teams.

EXPERIENCE

JPMorgan Chase & Co. — Corporate & Investment Bank Technology, Jersey City, NJ
Software Engineer (Associate) · July 2016 – Present

Trade Settlement Batch (2016 – Present)
• Maintain and enhance the overnight settlement batch for fixed-income trades, a Java and PL/SQL application processing about 400,000 trades per night
• Reduced the end-to-end batch runtime from roughly 6 hours to 4.5 hours in 2021 by reordering job dependencies and adding two indexes
• Handle production support rotation one week in five; resolve data and job failures and document root causes
• Implemented regulatory field changes for three reporting mandates between 2018 and 2024
• Migrated the job scheduler configuration from Autosys to the firm's internal scheduler in 2023
• Perform the quarterly disaster recovery test for the batch and update the recovery documentation
• Coordinate release testing with the operations user-acceptance team twice a quarter and prepare the release notes
• Maintain the batch's job dependency documentation and the runbook used by the overnight support team

Reference Data Service (2017 – Present)
• Maintain the REST service that provides security master and counterparty data to about 20 downstream applications
• Added caching in 2019 that lowered average response time from 180 ms to 95 ms
• Wrote and maintain the regression test suite (about 600 test cases) run before each release
• Coordinate quarterly data-quality reviews with the reference data operations team
• Handle access requests and onboarding questions from downstream teams
• Supported the 2022 migration of the service's database to a new Oracle version with the database team
• Respond to audit requests for access logs and change records

Reporting Portal (2016 – Present)
• Maintain the internal web portal (Java, Spring MVC, Oracle) used by operations staff to view settlement status and exceptions
• Delivered small enhancements each release cycle, such as new filters, export to Excel and additional exception categories
• Upgraded the application from Java 8 to Java 17 in 2024 as part of the firm-wide platform refresh
• Completed the annual security remediation items for all three applications each year
• Helped onboard new team members by walking them through the three codebases and the release process
• Fixed accessibility findings from the 2023 internal review (contrast, keyboard navigation)
• Added single sign-on integration in 2020 following the firm's standard pattern

Technology Analyst Program (rotational), JPMorgan Chase · July 2016 – June 2017
• Rotations in the settlement batch team and the reporting portal team; converted to the settlement team at the end of the program

EDUCATION
Rutgers University – New Brunswick, NJ
B.S. Computer Science, May 2016

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Java (8, 11, 17), Spring, PL/SQL, Oracle Database, Autosys, Jenkins, Git, Bitbucket, JIRA, Linux shell scripting, JUnit, Maven, SQL Developer, ServiceNow, Confluence, Splunk (basic), basic Python

TRAINING AND CERTIFICATIONS
• Oracle Certified Associate, Java SE 8 Programmer (2017)
• Internal courses: Secure Coding, Agile Fundamentals, Cloud Foundations (2022), Kafka Basics (2025)
• Attend the division's annual technology conference each year

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
• Consistently rated "meets expectations" in annual reviews
• Participate in the division's code review guild and the quarterly hackathon (team member, 2019, 2021, 2023)
• Registered for the firm's internal Java certification track, 2026
